{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:Opera_box.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Romeo Treblanc's private viewing box.]]
[[Romeo Treblanc]], owner and proprietor of the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]], possessed a '''private viewing box''' located just adjacent to the [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private box]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house was located on<ref name="Treblanc DB">{{DB|character|romeotreblanc|Treblanc, Romeo}}</ref> the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], within the planet-spanning [[City/Legends|city's]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> during a showing of the opera ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]'', Treblanc viewed the performance<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> alongside [[Onara Kuat]], [[Tannon Praji]], and [[Ottegru Grey]].<ref name="Kuat DB">{{DB|character|onarakuat|Kuat, Onara}}</ref> Despite being directly next to Palpatine's box,<ref name="ROTS" /> security features in the Chancellor's box made Treblanc completely unaware of events occurring just beside him,<ref name="Treblanc DB" /> like on that night at ''Squid Lake'' when Palpatine informed the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] of the [[Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise/Legends|Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the Wise]] as part of his scheme to turn Skywalker to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
This viewing box is full of important [[Industrial Light & Magic]] employees.<ref name="Insider 125">{{InsiderCite|125|Classic Moment|Classic Moment: The Tragedy of Darth Plagueis}}</ref> The ''[[What's The Story?]]'' feature of [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|''Hyperspace'']] has identified some of their characters.
